DOM and trace are sequential observations, not atomic. No page state, timer, visibility property or event was scripted. Interactions use actual buttons and normal focus.

Host still omits optional toolInfo, exactly as the failing before-fix fixture. Cold start scenario returns its retry immediately; board-race holds reads/moves/detail using actual AppBridge RPC.
After switching B, the visible move error banner clears. The existing visually hidden live announcement can retain the prior message; this run does not claim every DOM text node was cleared.
Focus can cause extra board reads, including request5 after detail B hydration; such reads are preserved in trace, not counted as completed if later cancelled.

Hidden/native-drag/detail-write-overlap matrix from prior HTML is not rerun here and keeps its original provenance. Source regressions preserve those tests; these new artifacts do not replace the prior matrix.
